persona: GST and accounts executive at a small CA firm moving to a tax associate role
resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Pune | sneha.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Tax and Accounts Executive, Kulkarni Patil & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Pune (2022 - present)

- Built Excel templates for advance tax computation used across the firm.

EDUCATION
B.Com, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2021
CA Intermediate (both groups), 2023

SKILLS
TallyPrime, MS Excel, GST portal, TRACES, Assessment proceedings
